label: illustrative
notes: ILLUSTRATIVE. A checker that cries wolf: more than half its findings are spurious (false_positive_rate 0.60), it drifts on re-run (mostly_stable), takes ~200s per review, and averages 4 rework loops. Even though it misses no real defect, ALARM_STORM forces UNRELIABLE / red — a reviewer that is wrong most of the time trains everyone to ignore it, including its true catches. Also carries VERDICT_DRIFT + SLOW_REVIEW + MULTI_LOOP warnings.
